name: film-crew
description: A film crew for making videos. Give the director a topic and a style and it runs the whole production: a screenwriter researches it and writes a script where every spoken fact carries two sources, a story editor engineers the hooks and open loops, a voice booth narrates it, a storyboard artist plans a visual beat every few seconds, and a production designer shoots it in a chosen style — archival paper collage or a broadcast news bulletin, with more added as folders. Cuts vertical Shorts from the hookiest moments, packages everything for YouTube, and publishes only what a human has approved. Also assembles long recorded sessions into episodes and Shorts.
